explication: NVIDIA Run:ai is a Kubernetes-based AI workload and GPU orchestration platform. Its principal flow starts with a user submitting a workload through the web UI, CLI, or REST API; the control plane manages and governs that request, cluster services synchronize it, and cluster-side scheduling runs it. Status and metrics return to centralized observability. The repository spans a large monorepo, so unsampled capabilities are represented at documented subsystem-directory level; sampled source confirms selected inference, storage-class, metrics, and cluster-controller responsibilities.
